title: To the editor: Stop funding Israel's military - NewsBreak
text:
By Related Story ,
1 hours ago
Media the world over was generally celebrating Trump’s cease-fire deal with Iran. Oil could soon flow out of the Strait of Hormuz as gas and diesel prices have already started coming down in America.
But part of the deal is that Israel must stop bombing and destroying villages in Lebanon and Israel has not agreed to do that and didn’t sign on to Trump’s Iran peace deal.
The following was reported in The Independent on June 18: “Vice President JD Vance delivered a stunning message to Israeli officials who have criticized the Trump Administration’s controversial peace deal with Iran. Shut up or risk losing American military aid.”
Vance further addressed Israel by saying, “The other thing that I would say is that over the last three months, two-thirds of the defensive weapons that have protected your homeland have been built by American hands and paid for by American tax dollars.”
That says it all. Israel and a handful of “Israel First” anti-American billionaires in America pushed Trump into bombing Iran in the first place and the cost to America for this war may well reach a trillion dollars all told. That is a huge burden on American taxpayers and will affect Social Security, health care, taxes we pay, food and grocery bills, fuel and fertilizer prices, and much more. We think the worst is over if gas prices decline but the increased cost of fuel and fertilizer are pushing food prices much higher now and in the coming months.
Already on June 19, CNN headlines read, “U.S.-Iran talks postponed as new Israel-Hezbollah clashes strain agreement.” Vance’s trip to Switzerland for further talks has been postponed and Israel has succeeded in derailing Trump’s peace plan before the ink was even dry. On June 20, CNN reported Iran had closed the Strait of Hormuz again and the price of oil is likely to stay high and the world economy will continue to collapse. Good-bye, Republican Party and many Israel-First Democrats, if Israel can’t be reined in.
Our government continues delivering missiles and bombs to Israel free of charge while wagging its finger saying, “Now don’t go bombing Lebanon.” Does that show that we really want the war to end? Yet that is the only way to end the war. Quit sending bombs and missiles to Israel. Let them pay for their own wars. Put America and ourselves first. Vote only for politicians of either party who promise to do just that.
ERNEST RYAN
Temperance
American freedom is at its very fringes
Will this be the last Fourth of July that we celebrate? If Republicans manage to keep their majority in both Houses of Congress through their gerrymandered maps, then Trump and the Republicans will continue their march toward an autocratic government.
If Trump and the Republicans are able to turn our country into an autocratic government with Trump as the autocrat, then you don’t celebrate independence in a country where you don’t have any independence. The Fourth of July will be replaced by the Fourteenth of June. This is the autocrat’s birthday.
We can expect to see some spectacle occurring on the White House lawn on his birthday like the recent cage match where one of the fighters stated that First Lady Michelle Obama is a man.
We will have to wait and see if after June 14 whether it still will be called Flag Day because Trump doesn’t like to share the spotlight.
In 2017, Trump pushed Montenegro Prime Minister Dusko Markovic out of the way in order to get to the front of the line at a NATO summit.
Democrats need to win the House of Representatives so that the much-needed oversight can be done to stop this march to an autocratic government. Remember, the House of Representatives certifies the 2028 presidential election.
Also, if the Democrats do not win the Senate, then Aileen Cannon and Emil Bove will be the next Supreme Court justices nominated by Trump and confirmed by a Republican Senate.
We need oversight from Congress and the Republicans have shown us that they have no interest in providing this oversight. A vote for any Republican will be a vote for Trump. If you regret your vote for Trump in the 2024 presidential election, then vote for the Democrat in the upcoming election.
It took Hungarians 16 years to realize that they didn’t want an autocrat because of all the corruption. Let’s not go down that same road but instead vote for a Congress that will put an end to Trump’s authoritarian regime and corruption now.
JAMES D. ANDERSON
Toledo
Take God out of Declaration too?
Recently you had a letter published asking us to remove the words “under God” from the Pledge of Allegiance.
It is an irony that we are so close to the 250th anniversary of the “Unanimous Declaration of the thirteen United States of America” (how often is anything agreed unanimously in our government?).
Perhaps this same writer, seeking inclusion, wants us to remove the references to: “God,” “their Creator,” “Supreme Judge,” and “the protection of divine Providence” from the Declaration of Independence as well?
MATTHEW SMITH
Springfield Township
